strategic_themes.label: Application process
strategic_themes.definition: All subjects related to how a customer initiates or completes a financing request, including speed, requirements, and approvals.

midlevel_themes.label: Approval time
midlevel_themes.definition: The duration from application submission to approval decision.

specific_themes.label: Fast approval
specific_themes.definition: Approval received within minutes or hours.

specific_themes.label: Slow approval
specific_themes.definition: Approval delayed to days or weeks.

midlevel_themes.label: Application requirements
midlevel_themes.definition: Documents or information required to submit an application.

specific_themes.label: Too many requirements
specific_themes.definition: Large number of documents or years of accounts demanded.

midlevel_themes.label: Adjusting terms after approval
midlevel_themes.definition: Ability to change credit lines or other terms without reapplying.

specific_themes.label: Adjustments allowed
specific_themes.definition: Terms can be modified after approval.

strategic_themes.label: Digital interface
strategic_themes.definition: All subjects related to the digital tools and user experience provided by the bank.

midlevel_themes.label: Portal performance
midlevel_themes.definition: Speed, stability, and usability of the online portal.

specific_themes.label: Fast portal
specific_themes.definition: Portal loads quickly and functions smoothly.

midlevel_themes.label: Mobile app
midlevel_themes.definition: Availability and functionality of a mobile application.

midlevel_themes.label: Integration capabilities
midlevel_themes.definition: How well the system works with accounting or other software.

specific_themes.label: Successful integration
specific_themes.definition: Smooth data exchange with external systems.

specific_themes.label: Integration failed
specific_themes.definition: Repeated failures or errors during integration.

midlevel_themes.label: Login and security
midlevel_themes.definition: Issues surrounding authentication and secure access.

strategic_themes.label: Pricing and terms
strategic_themes.definition: All subjects related to fees, rates, and contractual clarity.

midlevel_themes.label: Interest rate
midlevel_themes.definition: Whether the rate is fixed or variable and its transparency.

specific_themes.label: Variable rate
specific_themes.definition: Rate can change and may not be disclosed clearly.

midlevel_themes.label: Fee structure
midlevel_themes.definition: Presence, amount, and clarity of fees.

midlevel_themes.label: Contract clarity
midlevel_themes.definition: How clearly the terms are presented to the customer.

specific_themes.label: Terms unclear
specific_themes.definition: Contracts lack clarity or are difficult to interpret.

strategic_themes.label: Customer service
strategic_themes.definition: All subjects related to interactions with bank staff and support channels.

midlevel_themes.label: Staff behavior
midlevel_themes.definition: Tone, professionalism, and consistency of staff.

specific_themes.label: Rude staff
specific_themes.definition: Staff exhibit disrespectful or dismissive behavior.

midlevel_themes.label: Access to personal contact
midlevel_themes.definition: Consistency of speaking to the same representative.

midlevel_themes.label: Support channels
midlevel_themes.definition: Availability and quality of various support channels.

specific_themes.label: Channels available
specific_themes.definition: Chat, phone, and email options work.

specific_themes.label: Channels limited
specific_themes.definition: Some channels are missing or unresponsive.

strategic_themes.label: Product fit
strategic_themes.definition: How well the product meets the customer's needs and expectations.

midlevel_themes.label: Product suitability
midlevel_themes.definition: Whether the product matches the customer's business size and needs.

specific_themes.label: Suitable for small business
specific_themes.definition: Product fits a small or early-stage company.

midlevel_themes.label: Product flexibility
midlevel_themes.definition: Ability to adapt terms, credit lines, or usage without extra hurdles.
